target: AArch64 QEMU virt with ramfb and VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --probe-demo-stadium
checks: Launched unchanged pinned /Demo/Games/Stadium/Stadium.ZC in a focused application task; registered Stadium with the GUI terminal launcher after the first attempt exposed that it otherwise ran synchronously.
The Stadium scene rendered with visible graphics.
A left click triggered a pitch and changed the rendered scene.
Escape restored the graphical terminal; 40+2 evaluated to 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: QEMU game launch/render/mouse/exit acceptance; StadiumGen execution and live UTM or Pi hardware behavior are not implied.
